messages:
Anjali: Heads-up — Satellite Health dedicated tenant `sat-3` scheduled for staged rollout tonight. Target window 23:00-01:00 PT. Canaries at 10% then 50%. pinning to `v2.4.1-quant`
Matt: Thanks. Which slice and SLA thresholds should we enforce for auto-rollback?
Sara: Proposed rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 5m. Also abort if model quality regression > 3% on our smoke prompts.
Anjali: Agree. Add traffic-shift cooldown of 10m between ramps. No dataset-backed ops during window.
Leo (CSE): FYI customer on standby — Leo will confirm acceptance criteria with Satellite Health support team at 21:30 PT.
OpsBot: deploybot: Starting canary for tenant=sat-3 version=v2.4.1-quant slice=10% deploy_id=deploy-1715009876-canary
ReleaseBot: Release note: v2.4.1-quant — inference perf improvements, memory fixes. See https://go/release/1715009876
Matt: Pasting config I'll use for the rollout: ```
canary:
  tenant: sat-3
  version: v2.4.1-quant
  slice: 10%
  ramp_to: 50%
  windows: ["2026-03-20T23:00:00-07:00","2026-03-21T01:00:00-07:00"]
  rollback:
    error_rate: 1.5%
    error_window: 3m
    p95: 600ms
    p95_window: 5m
  cooldown: 10m
```
Sara: Also ensure KV cache warmup enabled for this tenant to avoid cold-start spikes — set `cache.prefill=true`.
Anjali: Confirming: Ops runbook pinned in repo under ops/playbooks/sat-3-rollout.md. Link: https://go/ops/sat-3
Leo (CSE): Customer acceptance criteria: no user-facing 5xxs, average token cost within 5% of baseline, and QA smoke prompts pass. I'll confirm ASAP.
Matt: ops:deploy — queued. ETA start 23:00 PT.
OpsBot: deploybot: Canary rollout started (deploy-1715009876-canary). Monitoring p95, error_rate, token_cost.
OpsBot: metrics snapshot (t+6m): error_rate=0.4% p95=310ms token_cost_change=-1.2%
Sara: Metrics look healthy. No alert.
Anjali: @Leo any word from customer?
Leo (CSE): They signed off on the canary criteria. Go for ramp to 50% at 23:40 PT if metrics remain stable. :thumbsup:
Matt: Ramp command queued. Note: will hold if any infra alerts or unexpected GC spikes.
OpsBot: deploybot: Ramping to 50% (deploy-1715009876-canary -> slice=50%).
OpsBot: metrics snapshot (t+20m): error_rate=0.9% p95=420ms token_cost_change=-0.8%
Sara: Still within thresholds. Gradual ramp looks good.
ReleaseBot: Note pinned: tenant sat-3 -> v2.4.1-quant until 2026-03-28 or explicit unpin request.
Anjali: Greencheck from infra + customer. Proceeding to full cutover schedule tomorrow during daylight window if no regressions.
Matt: Thanks team. I'll leave the deploy session open and close the thread after final verification.
OpsBot: deploybot: Canary completed successfully. Final status: OK.
Anjali: :tada: closing this rollout thread — follow-up doc in ops/playbooks/sat-3-rollout.md with lessons and ramp charts.
Matt: closing.
